text:
Alex Keller: Heads-up — PartnerX AWS Marketplace listing requires SOC2 Type II report, pen-test summary, and an HSM attestation for their integrated HSM. Partner asked for presigned upload links + redaction guidance. Target listing date is 2025-05-18. Who can own artifact ingestion?
Maria Perez: I can lead SOC2 & questionnaire mapping. Need an owner for pen-test artifacts and HSM attestation intake.
Sam Security: I'll take pen-test intake. For HSM we need vendor attestation (model, firmware, config) + a short e2e test plan. Confirm whether we can accept redacted pen-tests.
Jen Legal: Confirmed — redacted pen-tests are acceptable if accompanied by a signed attestation describing full scope and vulnerabilities withheld. Raw reports require an NDA. I can draft the NDA/AOD clause.
Owen Ops: For presigned uploads use s3://rwd-marketplace/artifacts/partnerx/<partner-id>/ ; TTL 7 days. I'll set bucket policy and create presign automation.
Owen Ops: ```bash
aws s3 presign s3://rwd-marketplace/artifacts/partnerx/partnerx-soc2.zip --expires-in 604800
```
Maria Perez: Also need a mapping sheet that maps each artifact to the marketplace checklist fields (SOC2 -> control matrix, pen-test -> executive summary + vuln table, HSM -> attestation + device manifest). I'll stub a spreadsheet and share.
Sam Security: Pen-test intake checklist: scope, testing firm, test dates, executive summary, full vuln table (severity + CVE + remediation ETA). Ask them for CVE references and remediation timelines.
Alex Keller: @Jen Legal please add required language about HSM firmware and key custody in the NDA. Loop in partner success to schedule upload window and clarify what can be redacted.
partners-bot: New partner onboarding created: https://partners.redwood.ai/onboard/PRTN-492
Maria Perez: I'll create a POA&M doc for artifact owners. Assigning: Sam Security = pen-test intake; Owen Ops = presign workflow; Jen Legal = NDA/AOD; Maria = SOC2/questionnaire mapping.
Owen Ops: I'll implement presign workflow and post the upload endpoints. Tagging @eng-sre for monitoring. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial presign endpoints.
Sam Security: Quick Q — do we accept pen-tests from third-party firms without Redwood-specific scoping if they include a signed statement of scope?
Jen Legal: Yes if the firm is accredited and scope is clear. We'll include a clause that partner must certify scope coverage for marketplace listing.
Alex Keller: Action items recap: Maria — spreadsheet + mapping links; Owen — presign + bucket policy; Sam — pen-test intake plan + checklist; Jen — NDA/AOD draft. I'll follow up in 48h and schedule a 30m sync with PartnerX next week.
Maria Perez: Stub spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/sheets/marketplace-partnerx-artifacts (will update permissions).
Sam Security: I'll also prepare a small checksum verification script and a minimal intake form for metadata.
Owen Ops: Example presign curl we can give partners for uploads:```bash
curl -X PUT -T soc2.zip "https://rwd-presign.example.com/upload?sig=..."
```
Alex Keller: If no objections, I'll set the calendar invite and include agenda: artifact list, redaction rules, timeline, and responsibilities.
Maria Perez: 30m sync works for me — add the mapping doc link and a short list of examples of acceptable redactions.
Jen Legal: I'll attend and be ready to escalate if they request raw reports without NDA.
Sam Security: I'll bring the pen-test intake checklist and the sample form. :thumbsup:
Alex Keller: Thanks team — closing thread for now, will post invite and follow-ups in 48h.
